methodology.name: Global Manufacturing Excellence Benchmark (GMEB)
methodology.description: Standardized methodology for cross-plant performance comparison

oee.validation: reported_oee should equal calculated_oee within 2% tolerance

rules.name: Suspiciously Constant Values
rules.description: Flag metrics with zero or near-zero variance across 12 months

rules.name: OEE Component Cross-Validation
rules.description: Verify that availability * performance * quality ≈ reported OEE

rules.name: Physical Plausibility
rules.description: Flag values exceeding physical limits (e.g., yield > 100%, OEE > 100%)

rules.name: Suspicious Rounding
rules.description: Flag metrics that are always round numbers (suggesting estimation rather than measurement)
rules.threshold: all values are multiples of 0.5 or integers

rules.name: Missing Seasonal Variation
rules.description: Manufacturing plants should show some monthly variation due to holidays, maintenance schedules, etc.

rules.name: Metric Correlation Validation
rules.description: Higher output should correlate with higher energy use; higher incidents may correlate with new employees
